descriptions.w3d_node_position: Returns a pointer to the scene node's position vector.
descriptions.w3d_node_rotation: Returns a pointer to the scene node's second vector, likely its rotation.
descriptions.w3d_node_scale: Returns a pointer to the scene node's third vector, likely its scale.
descriptions.w3d_node_flag: Returns the single flag bit stored beside the node's reference count.
descriptions.w3d_node_type: Returns the scene node's type byte.
descriptions.w3d_node_attachment: Returns the object attached to the scene node.
descriptions.w3d_node_child_count: Returns the number of entries in the node's child vector.
descriptions.w3d_node_has_parent: Returns 1 when the node has a parent, otherwise 0.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_get_class: Returns the SpriteSet class record, which also lists live SpriteSet objects.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_unlink: Removes a SpriteSet from its class list and decrements the live count.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_create: Allocates and constructs a SpriteSet and registers it in its class list.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_interfaces: Returns the SpriteSet interface table used by interface queries.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_release: Drops one reference; on the last one unlinks and deletes the SpriteSet. Returns the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_add_ref: Adds one reference to a SpriteSet and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_sprite_set_query_interface: Looks up a requested interface on a SpriteSet through its interface table.
